text:
Guadalajara, isi obodo na obodo kacha nwee mmadụ nke steeti Jalisco nke Mexico, e guzobere na 14 February 1542 na Atemajac Valley — nke ikpeazụ n'ime ọtụtụ mbugharị malitere na 1532. Na 1560 ọ ghọrọ isi obodo Nueva Galicia, na-eme ka ọ dị mkpa ọ na-ebu kemgbe ahụ. Mpaghara obodo ya, nke nwere ihe dịka nde mmadụ 5.3 dịka nke 2020, bụ nke atọ kacha ukwu na Mexico.

A na-akpọkarị obodo ahụ "most Mexican of Mexican cities," ma a na-enweta nkọwa ahụ: Guadalajara bụ obi nke mariachi, tequila, charrería na Ballet Folklórico, ọdịnala ndị kpụrụ onyinyo mba nke Mexico n'onwe ya.

Football na-agbada otu ụzọ ahụ. A na-ejikọta njirimara obodo ahụ gburugburu C.D. Guadalajara — nke a maara nke ọma dị ka Chivas — nke e guzobere na 1906 ma bụrụ otu n'ime klọb abụọ kacha ewu ewu na nwee ihe ịga nke ọma na Mexico, nke a ma ama maka ịkpọ naanị ndị egwuregwu Mexico. Chivas bụ onye nwe Estadio Akron, ama egwuregwu ọ wuru na 2010 na mpaghara Zapopan, akụkụ nke mpaghara obodo Guadalajara na ebe ama egwuregwu 2026 World Cup dị. Metro ahụ bụkwa ebe obibi nke otu Liga MX Atlas, na-enye obodo ahụ klọb nke abụọ n'ogo elu. Tupu Chivas wuo ala nke ya, Guadalajara mere egwuregwu na Estadio Jalisco nke akụkọ ihe mere eme, ama egwuregwu nke 1970 na 1986 World Cups — usoro nke na-etinye obodo ahụ n'etiti ụlọ nke football Mexico.
